The trivial module for the MY component

Source: R/adult-MY-trivial.R
trivialMY.Rd

The trivial MY module configures one of two forcing functions, either:

  • infectious biting: $$F_{fqZ}(t, V) = fqZ \times F_S(t, V_s) \times F_T(t, V_t) \times F_K(t, V_k)$$

  • egg laying: $$F_G(t, V) = G \times F_S(t,V_s) \times F_T(t, V_t) \times F_K(t, V_k)$$

where

  • \(G\) or eggs is the mean egg laying rate

  • \(fqZ\) is the product of f, q, and Z, the mean number of infectious bites on humans, per patch, per day

  • \(F_S(t,V_s)\) or F_season is a seasonal pattern function

  • \(F_T(t,V_t)\) or F_trend is a trend pattern function

  • \(F_K(t,V_k)\) or F_shock is a perturbation function

The implementation assumes that only one of these functions will be used, so it is not possible to configure different pattern functions for egg laying and infective biting.

Note

The variables \(V_s\), \(V_t\), and \(V_k\) are called by get_variables, which dispatches on the class of season_par or trend_par or shock_par.

season_par

dispatches get_variables to get \(V_s\)

trend_par

dispatches get_variables to get \(V_t\)

shock_par

dispatches get_variables to get \(V_k\)

  1. The module has no state variables.

  2. The size of an object saved by saveRDS balloons if it saves a function, so the saveXDS function strips the functions and readXDS remakes the function from the stored parameters.

F_season, F_trend, and F_shock can be set up manually by passing any user-defined function. If so, the user should use saveRDS and readRDS rather than saveXDS and readXDS.

Parameters

eggs

the mean number of eggs laid, per patch, per day

Z

the mean density of infectious mosquitoes, per patch

f

the blood feeding rate

q

the human fraction

F_season

a seasonal pattern function, \({F_S(t,V_s)}\)

F_trend

a trend function, \(F_T(t,V_t)\)

F_shock

a shock function, \(F_K(t,V_k)\)

By default, season_par, trend_par, and shock_par configure constant-one forcing functions.

For the bionomic parameters, f=q=Z=eggs=1.
